notes.title: DRUNKER PHYSICS UPDATE OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]https://scontent.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75416840_816761503229707_386437988726348652_n.png?_nc_cat=1&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=79b88e&_nc_ohc=dvdkykgRA6oAX_S-A0W&_nc_ht=scontent.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AfCWdG95vmKxiOwiRdmbzyDNUjj7Sd6DgbNBO0O7Mg3JAA&oe=6509FC17[/img]

[h1]Drunker Physics Update
[/h1]We heard you...
...The FIGHT now is even MORE DRUNK!
Hello, fighters! Our Community Feedback is hugely important for us when improving our game and your experience with Drunkn Bar Fight. Based on it, our team prepared a huge Update for you!
[h2]Changelog[/h2]:
[list]
[*] New Player's Hands: the player hands are now totally reworked! Say bye bye to the Skinny Hands 👋;
[*] New Player's models: the meshes from all the players characters were also reworked, so everyone got a fresh new look!;
[*] New Enemy Reactions: what else makes the fight even more immersive? How the enemies react to the fighting! Now, NPCs have brand new reactions that can vary in many different ways, depending on how and where you hit them. Not only that, we also added sweat particles to the enemies! The fighting is getting even more sweating, huh?;
[*] New Grabbing: now, you can grab items in many different ways and also, you can use both hands to grab an object or two at once. Imagine fighting a drunk dude with one hand and while enjoying a delightful drink with the other one?;
[*] And a ton of tweaks and bugfixes!  🔧 
[/list]

[previewyoutube=lxSV-gflVO4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Carnival update is LIVE! Come have fun at the Circus!
notes.notes:
[h1]Ladies and Gentlemen, welcome to our *Drunkn* Carnival![/h1]
[img]https://scontent.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39001681_1308639983255274_8300880564112541430_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=79b88e&_nc_ohc=w9jI4Xty3zoAX_X5HGa&_nc_ht=scontent.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AfAvyHdtdGxyGnIrw8Y9CpXpYZi6uOoVXwp1_w3JU7HEZA&oe=638CF1D3[/img]

Our team is happy to announce a brand new level, a boardwalk Carnival, where you can play with several popular booths.

Immerse yourself using hammers, cotton candies, hot-dogs, and many other weapons that will create absolute [b]mayhem [/b]in this not-so-family friend place.

[b]Or[/b] just get a drink, and enjoy watching each one of this characters talking about their lives.

[img]https://scontent.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75348041_1873978939615597_446162655899974698_n.png?_nc_cat=103&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=79b88e&_nc_ohc=ITOk1sXYG3kAX-mSHhV&_nc_ht=scontent.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AfDGTr0J_HgirWJpFGzZosx-_qA4IOccRSjocogg_qhIsA&oe=638BE983[/img]

In the end, this is [b]YOUR BAR[/b].

notes.notes:

notes.title: Small update today.
notes.notes:
We fixed a few bugs and added a new feature

Random weapons.    Now each time you play a level there are 5 spots which randomly hold an random weapon.   This will add more weapons to each level and provide additional variety each time you play.

There is also a new cell phone UI which organizes things a bit better and makes text more readable.

We also added "Notifications" which will help provide instructions and guidance on how to play better and get the most out of the game.

notes.title: UPDATE!!! New update has potential performance issue regarding new liquid shaders
notes.notes:
We just pushed a new build live and some folks are already alerting us that it doesn't run well on their machine.     This is likely due to the new liquid shaders we added.      If you are having an issue, please write us at Company.Munky@gmail.com so we can send you a test build.


If you are having trouble you can access the last build here:

To get the last working version of the game, log onto Steam, go to your library, right click on “Drunkn Bar Fight”. You should see a “Betas” tab. Click on it.

The password for the Beta is “LastbuildLastbuild”. After you enter it, the new beta should be listed in the dropdown menu under "Select the beta you would like to opt into:

As soon as you select the "lastbuild", the Steam client will start downloading the update.

UPDATE
-----------
We have a new build that uses the new liquid shaders but turns them off if the frame rate is too low.

If you are interested in helping us test this new build and confirm it works please get the new build and let us know in the comments below or write us at Company.Munky@gmail.com

The password for the Test Build is “testliquidtestliquid”
Branch name:  "liquidtest"

-----------

Sorry for the problems.     This is the second time we tried to release better liquid shaders ..... double fail.

notes.title: Performance Issues? UPDATE - Please see bottom of post
notes.notes:
A few players have reported that the game doesn't run as well in the latest release.     We recently added new liquid shaders that might be causing the issue.    We of course would like to fix the game in the next build but we want to make sure we identify the problem.    So, if you noticed that the game doesn't run as well, you would be doing us a great favor if you could post information about your system here below in the comments.    Or if you would prefer, please post them in our bug report: [url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/XSS7CQY] Bug reports 	[/url] 	

Please let us know:
1.  CPU
2.  Graphics card
3.  Size of RAM
4.  OS
5.  Directx version

UPDATE!!!!
We have put a new "test build" up on Steam that swaps out the liquid shader if your fps drops below a certain threshold.      Those that have had the performance issue, can you please download the new "test build" and test it for us.    Please report success or failure in the comments below.

To get the "test build":
In Steam, go to your library.
Right click on Drunkn Bar Fight
Select Properties.   You should see
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26868467/76df633ac140a0d520331d576f3fd2dc7b01f066.png[/img]

Click the "Beta" tab.   Type the access code into the textbox and hit "Check code".   
"liquidshader" should now appear in the drop down menu above.
Select it and it should begin downloading.  

Name of build:  liquidshader     Access code: LiquidShader

notes.title: Survey results and development update
notes.notes:
According to our customer survey results the top requested features are:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26868467/2585cc13ea8b0d33d775464e571b50e895a64f96.png[/img]

1.   Grabbing and throwing
2.   New Environments
3.   Breakable objects
4.   Gore
5.   Multiplayer Co-op
6.   Multiplayer competitive

Right now the team's focus is on multiplayer.    We are still a few weeks away from sharing a build that adds the feature.    We plan to start beta testing in about two weeks.    We will request and sign up Beta testers then.

After multiplayer is out, we will turn our attention towards grabbing and throwing.  

I would like to delay creating new environments until we get the first one right.   We need to make the bar a lot better.    After it is closer to final, we can begin designing new spaces and characters to fight.    

In parallel, we will begin adding breakable objects.    We are collecting ideas!   What do you guys want?   https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/MGNMKFM

A month ago, Gore was the top request feature but it has steadily been sliding down the list.     Adding Gore will completely change the tone of the game.    We are looking into how we can do it while still maintaining our less than serious attitude.  

thanks for all the feedback!!!!
